children: Madison Square Garden Entertainment disclosed potential conflicts arising from shared directors and officers and adopted a policy covering overlaps with MSG Rangers.
James L. Dolan leads Madison Square Garden Entertainment, Sphere Entertainment, MSG Knickerbockers and MSG Rangers, with additional director and legal officer overlaps.
Shared roles and ownership interests may create conflicts involving corporate opportunities, business arrangements or decisions affecting the companies differently.
The company’s articles address certain corporate opportunities and transactions involving Sphere Entertainment, MSG Knickerbockers and AMC Global Media.
Following the MSG Rangers distribution, the board adopted an overlap policy extending those provisions to company officers and directors serving MSG Rangers or its subsidiaries.
